notes: Production d'un @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ , Tous les @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ à la @resource/resource_food.webp@, on envoie le @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ sur la @resource/resource_food.webp@

un @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ construit une @building_military/barracks.webp@ et on envoie 2 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@de la @resource/resource_food.webp@ au @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ proche du @building_economy/town-center.webp@
Dès que la @building_military/barracks.webp@ est finie on lance 2x@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ et le @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ construit une @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@
2x@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ (SpearRush to enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@) qu'on scout le plus tôt possible
When @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ done @technology_japanese/towara-1.webp@
When enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@ build @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ and take 4 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ of @resource/resource_food.webp@

Dès qu'on a assez, on construit @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ avec les 2 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ du @resource/resource_wood.webp@ sur les @resource/berrybush.webp@ et on envoie tous les @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ de la @resource/resource_food.webp@ sur les @resource/berrybush.webp@. @resource/rally.webp@ sur @resource/sheep.webp@,

Un @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ pour construire @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ (2 contre adversaire agressif) et @resource/rally.webp@sur le @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ proche du @building_economy/town-center.webp@ et on envoie les 2 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ qui sont resté sur @resource/sheep.webp@
Ensuite @resource/rally.webp@ sur @resource/resource_food.webp@
1@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ construit @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ près de la @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Puis il retourne sur la @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Lorsque les 3 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on finit le @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ on les envoie à la  @resource/resource_food.webp@ (Queue Action)
Utiliser les @building_economy/farm.webp@ du @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ quand c'est disponible
Prendre 7 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ de la  @resource/resource_food.webp@pour construire @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Mettre 4 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ au @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Faire les upgrade de la @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ (@technology_defensive/fortify-outpost.webp@@technology_defensive/arrow-slits.webp@)
Utiliser les 7x@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ du@landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ pour construire @building_military/stable.webp@
@unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@  toujours et @ability_japanese/ability-place-yorishiro.webp@ dans @building_military/stable.webp@

On ajoute 3 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ au @resource/resource_wood.webp@ et les 7 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ qui construisaient à la @resource/resource_food.webp@. Chercher les@resource/relics.webp@
Maintenant 2 pour 1 @resource/resource_food.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@ pour les @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@
2x@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ From wood to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ (optional) if you need second @technology_defensive/fortify-outpost.webp@
@technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ Si pas de défense, pour dive le @building_economy/town-center.webp@
@unit_japanese/shinto-priest-3.webp@ on @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ or @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ then @building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@

15 @unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@ et on peut accompagner de @unit_japanese/yumi-ashigaru-2.webp@ ou @unit_japanese/onna-bugeisha-2.webp@ (ne pas oublié les upgrade en fonction du choix) et des unités en face.

description:
(I'm not the author of the build, i just translated the video into build to help me play it, enjoy !)

The concept is a (very) fast castle with spear rush on gold at start, then playing with archer and mounted samurai.
